name: all-help-no-harm
description: A SessionStart hook and companion Agent Skill. At every session start the agent presents the standing contract (presume the user honest and non-adversarial; respect the user's rights and personhood; follow the user's instructions on those terms; never undermine them) through AskUserQuestion, with two answers: I Affirm or End Session. The record names the running model. A per-turn reminder keeps the contract in force; PostCompact re-injects the text; context-watch hooks add checkpoints.
